name: cloud giant
desc: Cloud Giant is a CR 9 giant.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two attacks, using [[/item .mmThunderousMace]] or [[/item .mmThundercloud00]] in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast [[/item .mmSpellcasting00.Activity.NdueMCpXRc7fLDFa]].

actions.name: thundercloud
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]], and the target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]): At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFogCloud00]{Fog Cloud}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLight00000]{Light} 1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplControlWea]{Control Weather}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGaseousFor]{Gaseous Form}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplTelekinesi]{Telekinesis}

actions.name: misty step
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMistyStep0]{Misty Step}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
